observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and Storybook changes. No backend implementation, no entitlements API, no toolbar entitlements logic, no actual entitlement enforcement or rollout behavior. The documentation and Storybook changes are not independently sufficient to establish tier. No score.
